<function name="MousePos" parent="gui" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
<deprecated>Use <page>input.GetCursorPos</page> instead.</deprecated>

Returns the cursor's position on the screen, or 0, 0 if cursor is not visible.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">mouseX</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number">mouseY</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
